title: London's 1814 Beer Flood: Brewery disaster killed eight in bizarre tragedy
summary_full: On October 17, 1814, a catastrophic explosion at the Horse Shoe Brewery in London unleashed tons of beer onto the streets, tragically claiming the lives of eight individuals, including many women and children. Rescuers faced an arduous task as they navigated the wreckage to reach survivors trapped amid the ruins.
